summary.intent: Get the Callisto CLI ready for 1.0 by landing a series of stability fixes (camelCase JSON keys, standard error envelopes, single-meaning error codes, input validation) and then, after the user approved two recommendations, exit code 2 for usage errors and a cleanup batch.
summary.outcome: Four PRs (#498-#501) were reviewed, verified outside the sandbox, signed, pushed and given descriptions. The exit-2 branch (fix/usage-exit-code) was reviewed, given a changeset, verified and pushed, while the cli-polish agent was still running and no PR had merged or been reviewed yet.

repo: serde `rename_all` on an enum renames only variants; struct-variant fields need `rename_all_fields = "camelCase"`, and Deserialize-only Wire twins need the same attribute.
`docs/stability.md` freezes `--format json` report shapes, error-code meanings and exit codes from 1.0, which is why these renames and reclassifications had to land before 1.0.
Several release types use `deny_unknown_fields`, so renaming keys without aliases makes old receipts fail to load across an upgrade.
The `lifecycle_e2e_tests` and the pnpm/uv workspace tests need crates.io/npm/github network access and fail inside the sandbox; they must be re-run with the sandbox disabled.
Error codes E316/E317 are raised both for `--package` flag values and for `callisto.toml` content; exit 2 applies only when the error context starts with `--`.
Exit-code classification lives in `USAGE_CODES` and `USAGE_WHEN_FROM_FLAG_CODES` in `crates/callisto-cli/src/error.rs`; a test requires every code in docs/errors.md to be classified exactly once.
`pre enter` must allow dotted identifiers such as `beta.1`, while `snapshot --tag` stays single-identifier.
#500 and #501 both edit adjacent rows of `docs/errors.md`, and exit-2 and #499 both touch the `main.rs` error path, so merge order matters.

code.finding: Adds USAGE_CODES, USAGE_WHEN_FROM_FLAG_CODES and CliError::is_usage_error(), the single place deciding exit 2 vs exit 1.
Houses assert_no_snake_case_keys, which walks every JSON key at every depth. It does not cover MatrixReport, ReleasePr* or the decision/intent types.

workflow: Subagent and teammate reports are claims: re-run the checks, and do the mutation check per enum rather than trusting a combined one.
Review the agents' design calls, not just their diffs. Two corrections were needed: E111 meaning had been moved, and `pre enter beta.1` had been broken.
Run overlap and conflict checks between branches before opening PRs, and decide the merge order from them.
Use a dedicated verify script (pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, workflow-contracts) outside the sandbox, and run `cargo fmt` first because swapped code often fails on formatting alone.
Delegate PR description writing to parallel agents, then apply the bodies with `gh pr edit --body-file`.
Sandbox denial of `.git/config` can leave stray local branches when `git switch -c` partially fails.

friction: The sandbox blocked network access for e2e tests, so no single full-suite exit code was obtained inside it.
The sandbox denied writes to `.git/config`, so branch creation partly failed and left a stray `camelCaseFields` branch.
`trail link` and PR number lookup needed retries and sleeps because PRs were not immediately visible.
Subagents produced wrong judgment calls (E111 meaning, dotted pre tags) that needed correction.
The exit-2 agent did not confirm that the three network-failing tests also fail on the base.
open_items: Reviews and merges of #498-#501 are pending, with #500 needing to merge before #501 so the docs/errors.md conflict can be fixed.
The exit-2 branch needs an overlap check against #499 and a PR with a description. The user should also confirm borderline classifications (E169, E189, E230, E232, E233, E281, E299, E216-E218, E309).
Package-selector E316 errors from the identity resolver still exit 1 because the resolver does not know whether a selector came from a flag.

The cli-polish agent's results are pending: reject duplicate packages in `add`, fix the `snapshot --strict` help text, make `status` print `lastTag: null`, document that `version_command` cannot take quoted arguments, and reword the stability Changesets row.
From #500: E254 is still a catch-all, and user-reachable E171 sites in `release/binding.rs` and `release/derive.rs` are unverified.
Whether to add a `peeled_commit` serde alias on the Wire twin so receipts resume across an upgrade from 0.19 is undecided.
CI has not run on any of the PRs.
